newsitem.title: USA: General Medical terminates tender offer.
newsitem.headline: General Medical terminates tender offer.

text.p: General Medical Corp said Thursday it was terminating the tender offer and consent solicitation set forth January 7.
The move is a result of McKesson Corp's announcement on January 28 of its agreement to acquire General Medical Inc.

The company said it intends at no expense to the holder to return to the holder, or to credit the appropriate book-entry transfer account, any debentures tendered pursuant to the tender-offer as promptly as practicable.
The offer was in connection with its tender for, and solicitation of, consents to amendments to the indenture governing its 12 1/8 percent series A subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due 2005.
